# Mansha Hussain - Portfolio

## About
Mansha Hussain is a Software Engineering graduate and Full-Stack Developer based in Lahore, Pakistan. He builds responsive, scalable, and user-focused digital products by combining strong software engineering principles with practical expertise in web technologies and artificial intelligence.

- Backend: Node.js, Express, Python, FastAPI, RESTful APIs
- Data Science & ML: Python, Scikit-learn, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP
- Databases: MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Firebase, SQLite, MySQL
